P.name: Assassin's Mark
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Akali''' damages an enemy {{tip|champion}} with an {{tip|ability}}, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions. For 2 seconds, she gains {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 to 60 for 4|1 to 16}} {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving away from the center of the ring. Only one ring may be active at a time.
P.description2: When '''Akali''' exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while facing nearby enemy champions and becomes empowered with ''Swinging Kama'' for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.
P.description3: {{sbc|Swinging Kama:}} '''Akali's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|{{tt|'''doubled''' range|Not necessarily increased by 125, check notes}}}} and deal {{pplevel|35 to 53 for 7; then + 9*x for 6; then + 15*x|formula=+3 per level until lvl 7; then +9 until lvl 13, then +15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Five Point Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' unleashes kunai in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Targets beyond a certain range are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

Q.name: Five Point Strike 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' unleashes kunai in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Targets beyond a certain range are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

W.name: Twilight Shroud
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' restores {{sti|{{as|100 energy}}}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 2 seconds. She also detonates a smoke bomb a fixed distance away in the target direction, creating a circular shroud that expands over the next 5 seconds into a ring. The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions. While the shroud is active, '''Akali's''' {{as|'''maximum''' energy}} is increased by {{as|100|energy}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Shroud Duration|{{ap|5 to 7}} seconds}}
W.description2: Entering the shroud renders '''Akali''' {{tip|invisibility|invisible}}, unless she is {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
W.description3: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent '''Akali''' from entering it again for {{pp|changedisplay=true|round=3|1;0.9;0.825;0.725;0.625|1;7;10;13;16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.
W.description4: ''The {{ai|Shuriken Flip|Akali|marked}} section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.''
W.description5: '''''Akali''' can move during Twilight Shroud's cast time.''

E.name: Shuriken Flip
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|flips}} backward after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the cast time, and after the cast time throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
E.description2: The shuriken ''marks'' and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the enemy or the last ''{{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|smoke}}'' section hit for 3 seconds, during which ''Shuriken Flip'' can be recast to consume the mark.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals {{as|magic damage}} upon arrival.
E.description4: '''''Akali''' will not flip backwards if she is {{tip|immobilized}} or {{tip|grounded}} in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the cast time. {{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali}} and {{ai|Perfect Execution|Akali}} can be cast during the recast's dash.''

R.name: Perfect Execution
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 750 units in the direction of the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.
R.description2: ''Perfect Execution'' can be recast after a {{fd|2.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} within 10 seconds of the first activation.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} {{tt|800|Estimated}} units in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 70|formula=2.86% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 70% '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 210*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}
